title: Seed replay rewrites every seeded row that carries a password field on every boot: the existing row is read through engine.find, which masks the password, so isNoOpReplay compares the seed plaintext with the mask
body:
Carries the second half of #24562: the fifth churning showcase row, "Specimen — Full", whose cause is not a temporal spelling. #24562 keeps the temporal comparison, fixed by PR #24617.

Filing gate: ① — a product defect with a reproduction and a named location. Filed by `domain:engine` seat 2 (seat post #20966) · `os-warren` · `session_01AHeUBbe6S3JRawcpbLejXD`, from the `os-dev-report` on #24562 (6271901541, out-of-scope finding 1). In-flight derivation: #24562's own reproduction (all 132 showcase rows unchanged on a second boot) does not pass without it, so it is that card's in-scope remainder, this seat's own, with the parent's priority and lane.

reach: the parent card's public-boot measurement (two `objectstack dev` boots of the stock showcase on one file DB, read through `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_field_zoo`) names "Specimen — Full" among the 5 rows whose `updated_at` moves. After PR #24617, the dev's harness (every `examples/app-showcase` object definition and seed dataset, real `ObjectQL` + `SqlDriver` on one SQLite file DB) shows that row as the only one still rewritten, and `f_password` as its only key read as changed.

## What happens

- `examples/app-showcase/src/data/objects/field-zoo.object.ts` declares `f_password: Field.password({ ..., ackPlaintextMasking: true })`, and the showcase seed writes `f_password: 'hunter2'` for "Specimen — Full".
- `SeedLoaderService.loadExistingRecords` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts`) reads the existing rows through `engine.find`. `ObjectQL.maskSecretFields` (`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`, fed by `collectMaskedReadFields`) masks every `password` field on a generic object on read, in every context, the seed's system context included.
- So `isNoOpReplay` compares the seed's plaintext with the mask, reads it as changed, and rewrites the row on every boot: `updated_at` moves, lifecycle validation runs again, and history can record an edit nobody made. That breaks `platform-core.seed-integrity` acceptance[3] ("upsert with externalId no-ops on unchanged rows") the same way #24562 did.
- Any app that seeds a row with a `password` field is affected, not only the showcase.

## The decision a fix needs (measured first by the claimant)

How a replay compares a value its own read path masks. Three shapes, from the dev's report:
- **A.** Compare against the stored value through a read that is not masked for the seed loader only. This crosses the secret-masking boundary, so if it needs a new unmasked read seam it goes to the maintainer before any code (a security boundary is not a seat call).
- **B.** Treat a masked field as not comparable: it never blocks the skip. A changed seed password is then never re-applied on replay, which is a silent drop of a declared seed value.
- **C.** Keep rewriting. The churn stays.

The claimant measures first: how the field is stored (`ackPlaintextMasking: true` reads as plaintext at rest), whether an existing unmasked read for system callers already exists (the engine's raw-read or masking-exempt paths), and what `history` records today on each churned replay.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repository, closed included: "seed replay password field masked rewrites row every boot updated_at isNoOpReplay maskSecretFields" → 4 hits: #24562 (the parent), #21787 (closed, credential-field handling on writes, a different clause), #3434 and #3433 (closed, other replay defects). None covers this mechanism.

Dedupe words: seed replay password masked updated_at churn; isNoOpReplay SECRET_MASK; maskSecretFields seed loader existing row.
